description: This file defines a utility namespace 'GatewaySettingsStore' containing static methods and properties for managing gateway-related settings, credentials, and persistent state, primarily using Keychain for secure storage and UserDefaults for configuration overrides. It also includes a 'GatewayDiagnostics' utility for log management and diagnostics.

methods.name: bootstrapPersistence
methods.description: Initializes persistent gateway settings, ensuring stable IDs are generated and stored.

methods.name: loadStableInstanceID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored stable instance ID from Keychain.

methods.name: saveStableInstanceID
methods.description: Stores the provided stable instance ID into Keychain.

methods.name: loadPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred gateway stable ID from Keychain.

methods.name: savePreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the preferred gateway stable ID into Keychain.

methods.name: clearPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Deletes the preferred gateway stable ID from Keychain and UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the last discovered gateway stable ID from Keychain.

methods.name: saveLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the last discovered gateway stable ID into Keychain.

methods.name: clearLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Deletes the last discovered gateway stable ID from Keychain and UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored gateway token associated with an instance ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores a gateway token associated with an instance ID into Keychain.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token for a gateway instance.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the bootstrap token for a gateway instance.

methods.name: clearGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Deletes the bootstrap token for a gateway instance.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the stored password for a gateway instance.

methods.name: saveGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores a password for a gateway instance.

methods.name: loadTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for a talk provider.

methods.name: saveTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Stores the API key for a talk provider.

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionManual
methods.description: Stores manual gateway connection details (host, port, TLS, stableID).

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionDiscovered
methods.description: Stores discovered gateway connection details (stableID, TLS).

methods.name: loadLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Loads the last saved gateway connection details, handling migrations from legacy UserDefaults.

methods.name: clearLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Removes stored last gateway connection data.

methods.name: deleteGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Deletes stored gateway credentials (tokens and passwords) for a specific instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Retrieves the client ID override for a specific gateway stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Stores a client ID override for a specific gateway stable ID.

methods.name: loadGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Retrieves the selected agent ID for a given gateway stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Stores the selected agent ID for a given gateway stable ID.
